Several DPSPs have been implemented through laws and policies

items: Exams frequently ask to match specific implementation laws (like MGNREGA or Panchayati Raj) with their corresponding DPSP articles.
Note the evolutionary path of provisions moving from non-justiciable DPSPs to enforceable Fundamental Rights, such as the Right to Education.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Directive Principles are operationalized through specific legislative enactments and government schemes.
The Panchayati Raj System fulfills the directive for democratic decentralization and local self-government.
The Right to Education acts on constitutional directives to ensure free and compulsory education.
MGNREGA directly supports the directive principle regarding the right to work and adequate means of livelihood.
Environmental protection laws enforce directives aimed at safeguarding forests, wildlife, and the environment.
